dependency_policy: Node.js 24 built-in modules only; no npm packages, no node_modules, no package.json dependencies
agent_notes: Keep every TypeScript source file under `src/` with the entry module `src/picc.ts`; the fixed build command compiles that tree into `dist/` and fails on any type error under `--strict`, so a snapshot that does not type-check has no compiler. Write explicit type annotations for function signatures and data structures (for example interfaces or type aliases for tokens, AST nodes, and IR), prefer precise types over `any`, and never suppress the checker with `// @ts-nocheck`, `// @ts-ignore`, or `// @ts-expect-error`. The emitted code is CommonJS; do not add a `package.json`.

spec_variables.DEPENDENCY_POLICY: Node.js 24 built-in modules only; do not add package.json dependencies, node_modules, or install packages
spec_variables.BUILD_COMMAND: tsc --strict --noEmitOnError --target es2022 --lib es2022 --module commonjs --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --typeRoots /usr/local/lib/node_modules/@types --rootDir src --outDir dist src/picc.ts
